ItemID: 1; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need.
ItemID: 2; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Useful for my TV and Blu-ray setup, but I would check whether I need a ten-foot cable before buying.
ItemID: 3; Title: Cat 6 Ethernet Cable 1 Ft (6Pack), Outdoor&Indoor, 10Gbps Support Cat7 Network, Heavy Duty Flat Internet LAN Patch Cord, Solid High Speed Weatherproof Cable for Router, Modem, Xbox, PS4, Switch, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I use networking accessories, but I have no immediate need for six one-foot cables.
ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a fourth-generation Echo Dot and would not choose an older model now.
ItemID: 5; Title: TOZO T10 Bluetooth 5.3 Wireless Earbuds with Wireless Charging Case IPX8 Waterproof Stereo Headphones in Ear Built in Mic Headset Premium Sound with Deep Bass for Sport White (2022 Upgraded); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My current interest is in home electronics and computer accessories; I am not looking for earbuds today.
ItemID: 6; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought a second-generation Echo Show 5 and its stand, so this older version feels redundant.
ItemID: 7; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Fire TV Stick 4K Max makes this previous-generation streaming device unnecessary.
ItemID: 8; Title: WYZE Cam v2 - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have bought a door alarm, but I do not currently have a specific need for a home camera.
ItemID: 9; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my history of storage accessories, but I would first check which device needs another card.
ItemID: 10; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this with a lamp because it adds a useful function to the Alexa devices I already own.
